in_marathi.name: Bharatvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of Bharat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharatvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharatvansh is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It is the name of the lineage or dynasty of Bharat, who is one of the two principal brothers in the Hindu epic Mahabharata. It signifies the connection with the ancient and revered Indian culture and mythology.

vedic_reference.note: Bharatvansh is the name of the royal dynasty of the Kurukshetra kingdom and the ruling family of Hastinapur. It is the lineage of Bharata, who is the eldest brother of the Pandava brothers, Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna, Nakula, and Sahadeva.
